releaseNotes:
CMF Buds Pro 2 Manager v2.3.4:
• Fixed fragmented Bluetooth protocol packets being dropped during SPP/GATT reads
• Bound the audio lab timer to the ViewModel lifecycle to prevent background coroutine leaks
• Fixed Windows PC Manager UI updates from its audio worker thread
• Corrected ADB Toolbox battery display to show the actual percentage
• Release workflow now fails instead of silently publishing a debug APK
